theorem matrix_rank_normal_form {n : ℕ} {F : Type*} [Field F] (A : Matrix n n F) :
  ∃ (P Q : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup n F),
    ∀ i j : Fin n,
      (P.val * A * Q.val) i j = 
        if (i : ℕ) < Matrix.rank F A ∧ (j : ℕ) < Matrix.rank F A then 
          if i = j then 1 else 0 
        else 0 := sorry
